# KRL Construction & Development, LLC

> KRL Construction & Development, LLC is a Custom home builder serving Rusk County, Texas. KRL Construction & Development is a custom home builder and general contractor serving Longview, Tyler, Bullard and surrounding East Texas communities. We build custom, spec and build-to-rent homes and handle residential and commercial construction, remodeling, framing and finish
